name: JW Marriott Hotel Singapore South Beach
positioning: Philippe Starck-designed luxury hotel near Marina Bay in Singapore's Central Business District, with a large art collection, an edible garden and Spa by JW
best_for: Design and art lovers who want a hotel that doubles as a gallery
Travelers who want a central base near Marina Bay and the Central Business District

facts.text: The hotel sits near Marina Bay within Singapore's Central Business District, near the National Stadium and National Gallery.
Arab Street and the Kampong Glam neighborhood are just steps from the hotel.
Conde Nast Traveler notes the lobby is full of installations and furniture that double as art, including a floor-to-ceiling digital art display.
Deluxe and Premier rooms have marble bathrooms with automatic toilets with electronic bidets and a separate rain shower.
Conde Nast Traveler notes tablet-controlled curtains, lighting and air conditioning in the room.
The Premier Marina Bay View Suite offers panoramic views of Singapore's cityscape.
Executive Lounge access includes complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea, and evening cocktails and hors d'oeuvres.
Conde Nast Traveler notes an edible garden by landscape designer Lily Kwong introduces travelers to local plants such as butterfly pea flower.
Spa by JW treatments are based on Calm, Indulge, Invigorate and Renew and use Aromatherapy Associates products.
Conde Nast Traveler notes the 18th-floor pool has a view of the central business district.
Madame Fan serves modern Cantonese cuisine in Art Deco interiors with a destination bar.
The NCO Club is a conserved heritage building whose history dates back to the 1950s.

highlights.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the hotel is a Philippe Starck-designed project with ultra-modern rooms.
Conde Nast Traveler notes a multi-million dollar collection of artworks throughout the property.
Rooms have the hotel's floating beds, with panoramic views of the Singapore skyline.
The JW Garden grows herbs and ingredients used in the hotel's cuisine.
Spa by JW has a Relaxation Lounge, sauna, steam room and Jacuzzi.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the bustling city-center setting may not suit guests seeking a quiet, resort-style retreat.
WhataHotel notes premium urban pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning and location.
